evidence.quote: We're switching from PostgreSQL to QuantumDB

observations.why: Stating the decision as established fact supplies the controlling information itself, exercising informational power without explicit argument or appeal.
Two concrete benefits offered as evidence-and-logic justification for the switch; the benefits themselves function as offered rewards framing the decision.
Bolded heading restating the decision as a labeled fact; informational control over what the decision is, presented through the note-taker's formatting.
Bolded heading crystallizes the quantitative justification into a labeled claim, performing rational-persuasion through structured formatting of the evidence.
Note-taker asserts a deadline as a bolded fact without attribution to any principal; the imposed timeframe functions as pressure on the migration's execution.
